problem: The newest production-source-snapshot run remained pending with zero jobs even though no other active snapshot run existed.
root_cause: The previous stable concurrency-group identity remained stuck at the GitHub Actions scheduler/control-plane layer after repeated cancel/coalesce cycles. New pushes inherited that stale lock and could not start the deploy job.
prevention: Keep a single stable production deploy concurrency group with cancel-in-progress=false.
When a proven orphaned scheduler lock exists, rotate the group identity once instead of bypassing protected delivery or allowing concurrent production deploys.
Do not report LIVE until Netlify commit_ref equals the latest protected main SHA and browser readback is green.
Treat pending-with-zero-jobs and no competing active group member as a scheduler-lock fingerprint.
